name: Editor
description: Markdown editor with outline sidebar, live preview, and vim mode

_notes.filesystemDeferred: File read/write capability is intentionally NOT declared. api.files.* calls (open, save, readFromPath, writeToPath) will not work under v2 until the filesystem capability model is finalized. UI/pane layout/CodeMirror/autosave-to-datastore still work.
_notes.lazyEventInterceptors: The v1 main.ts registerLazyEventInterceptors() path hardcodes loading 'editor' via the v1 extension host iframe when 'editor:open' or 'editor:add' are published. Under v2, editor's background tile is launched via tile-launcher (separate BrowserWindow, not iframe), so the v1 interceptor path will not wake up the v2 tile. The editor command stub (registered via tile-lazy.ts) still works for direct invocation. This means programmatic publishes of editor:open / editor:add from before the tile is loaded will not trigger tile load under v2 — the tile is only loaded by its own command or by another (already-loaded) tile publishing these events. Fix: tile-lazy.ts should gain an event-interceptor registration API parallel to its command-stub API.
